caption_used: Mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers, comparing pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline configurations. The hidden state mean before gate (blue dashed line, avg 0.71) remains near zero through approximately layer 15, then rises sharply to a peak of roughly 2.8 at layer 23. The post-gating hidden state mean (orange dotted, avg 0.05) and baseline mean (green solid, avg 0.04) both remain close to zero throughout, with the baseline showing marginally higher values than the post-gating mean in the final layers. The dramatic pre-gating increase beginning at layer 12 demonstrates that gating effectively suppresses the activation amplification observed in deeper layers.

raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: Фигурата илюстрира промени на средната абсолютна стойност на скритите състояния по слоеве чрез линейна диаграма с три серии. Оста X е означена „Layer“, със линейна скала и показани етикети при 0, 5, 10, 15 и 20 (слоевете се простират приблизително от 0 до 23). Оста Y е означена „Abs Mean“, със линейна скала и видими деления от 0 до 4 през 1 единица. Първата серия е синя прекъсната линия („hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71“), която започва близо до 0 при слой 0, остава около ~0.2–0.5 до приблизително слой 18, след което нараства рязко: около ~0.9 при слой ~19–20, достига около ~2.6 при слой ~21–22 и завършва с максимум около ~4.4 при слой ~23. Втората серия е оранжева пунктирна линия („hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05“), която остава близо до 0 по цялата ос X, с леко покачване към края до приблизително ~0.1. Третата серия е зелена плътна линия („hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04“), също близо до 0 през всички слоеве, с постепенно увеличение в последните слоеве до приблизително ~0.1; и двете ниски серии (оранжева и зелена) се движат почти по оста Y=0 без отчетливи пикове.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: 该图为单面板折线图，标题为“Hidden State Mean”，用于展示并对比不同设置下隐藏状态均值的绝对值（Abs Mean）随模型层数（Layer）的变化。x轴标签为“Layer”，为线性刻度，范围约从0到23，主要刻度显示为0、5、10、15、20（间隔为5）。y轴标签为“Abs Mean”，为线性刻度，范围约从0到4.5，主要刻度为0、1、2、3、4（间隔为1）。图例位于左上角，包含三条数据序列：蓝色虚线表示“hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71”，橙色点虚线表示“hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05”，绿色实线表示“hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04”。蓝色虚线在层0附近约为0.05，随后在前期层数（约1–18层）整体处于较低水平并缓慢波动（大致在0.2–0.5附近），在约19层上升到接近0.9，20层略回落后在21层附近出现明显跃升至约2.6，22层仍在约2.6左右，最终在23层达到最高点约4.3。橙色点虚线整体贴近0轴，从层0接近0开始，随层数缓慢上升，在中后段（约14–20层）逐步接近约0.08–0.10，21–22层略有小幅波动，23层约在0.10左右。绿色实线同样接近0轴起步，随层数平缓上升，在约15层后逐渐接近0.05–0.10区间，20层附近约0.10，21–22层略有起伏，末端23层约0.11左右。整体上，蓝色虚线在后段层数出现显著陡增，而橙色与绿色两条线在全层范围内保持低幅度、近零的缓慢变化。
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a multi-series line plot titled “Hidden State Mean” showing mean absolute hidden-state values across network layers for three configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” on a linear scale, spanning roughly layers 0 to 23 with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “Abs Mean” on a linear scale, ranging from about 0 to a little above 4 (top values near 4.4). Three lines are shown with a legend: a blue dashed line labeled “hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71,” an orange dotted line labeled “hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05,” and a green solid line labeled “hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04.” The blue dashed series starts near 0 at layer 0, stays around ~0.2–0.5 through the mid layers, then increases after about layer 18 (around ~0.9 by layer 19–20), jumps to roughly ~2.6 around layer 21–22, and ends near ~4.4 at layer 23. The orange dotted series remains close to 0 across all layers, gradually rising to around ~0.1 by the final layers with a small dip near about layer 21. The green solid baseline series also stays near 0 throughout, slowly increasing and ending around ~0.1 near layer 23, closely tracking the orange series in the later layers.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Das Diagramm ist ein Liniendiagramm mit dem Titel „Hidden State Mean“ und zeigt mittlere absolute Hidden-State-Werte über Modellschichten für drei Konfigurationen. Die x‑Achse ist mit „Layer“ beschriftet, linear skaliert und zeigt ganzzahlige Layer von 0 bis 23 (Ticks bei 0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y‑Achse ist mit „Abs Mean“ beschriftet, linear skaliert und reicht von 0 bis 4 (Ticks bei 0, 1, 2, 3, 4). Es gibt drei Datenreihen mit Legende: (1) eine blau gestrichelte Linie „hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71“, die bei Layer 0 nahe 0 startet, bis etwa Layer 18 überwiegend im Bereich um ca. 0.2–0.5 verläuft, dann ansteigt (um Layer 19 etwa ~0.9), kurz darauf stark zunimmt (um Layer 21 etwa ~2.6), bei Layer 22 etwa ~2.5 liegt und bei Layer 23 auf etwa ~4.4 ansteigt; (2) eine orange gepunktete Linie „hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05“, die über alle Layer nahe 0 bleibt und erst in den späten Layern leicht ansteigt (gegen Ende etwa ~0.1); (3) eine grüne durchgezogene Linie „hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04“, die ebenfalls nahe 0 beginnt und über die Layer langsam zunimmt, in den letzten Layern Werte um ungefähr ~0.1 erreicht und dabei nahe an der orangefarbenen Linie verläuft.
